integrity: All finite calculations use exact arithmetic, verified in two independent finite-field presentations per degree; the external primary source establishes the family, not the newly reported enumerated Weil spectrum.
scientific_limitations: 101 coefficient-marked rational parameter pairs in the normalized family only; no isomorphism-class census, and no full Newton polygon classification for the other 99 curves. Published superspecial and Cartier methods are prior work; earlier unindexed numerical tabulations are a priority risk.
title: Sixty-nine Weil types and two supersingular members of an order-six genus-four family over \(\mathbb F_{11}\)
